sampling: Latin hypercube on the unit cube, mapped by the Normal inverse CDF per parameter
prior: independent Normal(prior_centre(fit$best$theta), sd = 0.2/0.2) on log-scale theta
exclusion_rule: drop draws outside the parameter bounds (within_bounds), draws whose entry flow cannot supply the first-arrest flow (first_arrest_rate) and simulations that are non-finite or fail check_equilibrium (10-year lag); no replacement
